LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.7 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Drawing inferences • Comprehension By t
Topic 2.9: Reading Aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud, part of Reading 2.7 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Drawing inferences • Comprehension By t in Grade 5 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to pay attention to punctuation marks when reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. look at pictures of common items or things in the classroom and read their correct name (铅笔、 书 、黑板、椅子、桌子、橡皮、粉笔、尺 子),

2. read out the location of different classroom items or things using the correct preposition ( 前边、后 边 、旁边),

3. read out the location of the items or things placed in different parts of the class as their peers locate them (e.g. 我的书在桌子上),

4. record reading passages on the location of common items, things or people in the classroom and observe punctuation pauses for self-assessment and reflection,

5. read aloud simple sentences related to giving location of items in the classroom and focus on pronouncing the words accurately,

6. take turns to read and respond to questions on location of items, things or people using the sentence structure ......在哪儿? (e.g. 椅子在哪 儿 ?).

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. look at pictures of common items or things in the classroom and read their correct name (铅笔、 书 、黑板、椅子、桌子、橡皮、粉笔、尺 子),
2. read out the location of different classroom items or things using the correct preposition ( 前边、后 边 、旁边),
3. read out the location of the items or things placed in different parts of the class as their peers locate them (e.g. 我的书在桌子上),
4. record reading passages on the location of common items, things or people in the classroom and observe punctuation pauses for self-assessment and reflection,
5. read aloud simple sentences related to giving location of items in the classroom and focus on pronouncing the words accurately,
6. take turns to read and respond to questions on location of items, things or people using the sentence structure ......在哪儿? (e.g. 椅子在哪 儿 ?).

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learner: The learner reflects on their own reading aloud performances, identifying areas for improvement as they

record reading passages on the location of common items with appropriate punctuation pauses.

Values:
Unity: The learner takes turns reading and responding to questions on the location of various items, things or people with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental awareness is developed as the learner becomes aware of the location of the various items and things in

the classroom environment.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner relates the concept of giving the location of places to their learning of map reading in Social Studies.
